text: The Solicitor, Legal Services will provide a training and education session on Reconsideration Requests at the Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal. The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal may meet in closed session on this item in accordance with the provisions of the City of Toronto Act, 2006 which permits the closing of a meeting for the education or training of the Members.

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 from the Solicitor, Toronto Legal Services remain confidential in its entirety, as it pertains to the education or training of the Members.
